findings.text: both gate logs - this one and gate-lanes.log - are bare pytest output with no first line naming the revision, the tree and the command, though the node's own baseline-tests.log carries exactly that header, so a later reader cannot tie 37 passed or 2 failed/73 passed to 82095575 without re-running; the baseline header's command line also carries an unexpanded $W placeholder, so the printed command is not literally the one that ran.

the docstring's skip claim: a value that does not parse is passed over for the next field, so a malformed budget stamp cannot shadow a lifecycle stamp behind it - true by probe (garbage block stamp beside a valid started_at answers the started_at on both surfaces) but held by no case; the one-stamp case's undated sub-case has no budget block, so a regression returning the unparsable block value would leave the 37 green while both surfaces published a value that is not a stamp.

item_verdicts.diff: reviewed commit by commit against c0e95c1b. c011b6f9 promotes the key list to _RUN_STAMP_KEYS with run_observed_stamp returning text beside _run_observed_at reparsing that text to an instant, makes mcp_views._receipt_observed_at a delegate that keeps its name and both call sites, and adds the three cases; 82095575 carries the plan landing record, the evidence anchor and the figure, insert-only.
item_verdicts.done_when: every clause checked at 82095575. My own gate re-run is 37 passed EXIT=0 with in-process provenance naming the reviewed tree's budget.py (review-gate-rerun.log). The existing 34 pass unchanged: the test diff is +141/-1 and the single deletion is the import line that adds mcp_views. The declared mutation is applied to a scratch copy, its red log's first line repeats the mutation verbatim, and the named case is the only one that reddens; I re-derived that myself. The one clause unsatisfiable as written is the fence's own - no lanes-view test covers the moved helper - and the node measured this rather than assuming it (lanes-helper-coverage.log: reinstating the pre-change key list leaves the four lanes-view files at exactly the same 2 failed, 36 passed), then landed the in-fence equivalent by asserting the stamp where a reader reaches it, through crew_lanes_view itself, which my falsifier B shows has teeth.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's three goals are all landed, and I verified each independently rather than from the record. The production branch of _read_rollout is exercised: the new case calls recorded_windows with no rollouts= and patches the module-level reader, and my own scratch-copy re-derivation of the declared mutation reddens exactly that case (1 failed, 36 passed, review-falsifier-a). One helper holds the field list: budget.run_observed_stamp is the single definition, mcp_views._receipt_observed_at is a one-line delegate with no key list left anywhere in mcp_views (grep), and my scratch-copy falsifier reinstating the pre-change list reddens exactly the one-stamp case (review-falsifier-b). The mixed clock is asserted, not changed: a weekly-only winner one minute old reports seven_day observed and five_hour None beside a three-hour-old row that carried both.
item_verdicts.manifest: records both commits, the gate and the five-file delta (2 failed/70 passed at base, 2 failed/73 passed at head, the same two ids both sides), the declared mutation with its red case, artifact sha256s that all match the files on disk, and the honest coverage follow-on; the lint delta it states as 6 -> 6 is reproduced by my own measurement under the project config (base 6, head 6, identical sets). Its wait block carries "none" where no external condition was awaited - informative, though the contract reserves those keys for a real wait.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff --numstat c0e95c1b..82095575 lists exactly the six declared paths - reckon/budget.py 40/16, reckon/mcp_views.py 9/15, tests/test_preflight_pace.py 141/1, docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html 64/0, docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html 164/0, docs/figures/a-window-paces-the-lane/one-stamp-reader-and-the-wholesale-winner.svg 80/0. Every docs change is insert-only, so no plan-version or plan-modified line moved; the reviewed worktree was clean before and after my re-runs.

justifications.durability: each of the three cases was shown to fire by my own falsifiers, the expectations are derived from the fixtures rather than hardcoded, the undated sub-case asserts the published "unmeasured" outcome as well as None, and the mixed-clock case now guards an interaction my previous review measured as unheld - against one deduction: the docstring's claim that an unparsable stamp cannot shadow a field behind it is true but unheld (I probed a garbage budget stamp beside a valid started_at and both surfaces answer the started_at, 2026-09-21T16:00:00Z), so a regression returning the unparsable value would leave the 37 green.
justifications.evidence: the evidence is strong and each item is re-derivable - my gate re-run with in-process provenance, two independent falsifiers, artifact sha256s matching the manifest, the base delta with identical failure ids, the lint delta reproduced - against two deductions: both gate logs are bare pytest output whose first line does not name the revision, tree and command the contract asks for, while the node's own baseline log carries exactly that header, so tying 37 passed (or 2 failed/73 passed) to 82095575 required my re-runs rather than the artifacts; and the baseline log's header records its command with an unexpanded $W placeholder, so the command printed is not literally the one that ran.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's own idiom: the key list is promoted to a named constant with a comment stating why one reader serves both surfaces, the public helper carries a mechanism docstring, mcp_views keeps its function name and both call sites as a one-line delegate, and the improvement in behaviour (a malformed stamp is passed over instead of returned) is documented and asserted - against one wrinkle: the text/instant pair round-trips every stamp through str() and reparse, a small cost a caller holding the parsed instant could avoid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three stated goals are met and each is held by an assertion with teeth, verified by my own re-runs: the uninjected path reaches the production reader (my falsifier A reddens exactly that case), the field list is decided in one place with mcp_views delegating and no copy left behind (my falsifier B reddens exactly the one-stamp case), and the mixed-clock outcome is asserted so a later change to the wholesale choice has to face it.
justifications.scope_discipline: exactly the six declared paths in the delta, docs insert-only, the four lanes-view test files untouched as the fence requires, no plan-version or plan-modified line moved, and the added code, comments and test docstrings name no plan, sprint, gate or ticket label - they describe the mechanism.
